explanation: From the Sea of Marmara, ships continue through the Dardanelles to the Aegean, so a voyage from the Black Sea to the Mediterranean passes both straits.

claims.text: At its southern end the Bosphorus opens into the Sea of Marmara.
The Bosphorus does not open directly into the Aegean Sea, the Sea of Azov or the Caspian Sea.
The Dardanelles connect the Sea of Marmara to the Aegean Sea.
Ships sailing from the Black Sea to the Mediterranean pass through both the Bosphorus and the Dardanelles.
